pitch:
Category: Abstract.
Subject: hanging mobile.
Style: Alexander Calder.
reasoning:
I'm thinking of this as a Calder-style hanging mobile suspended from a ceiling hook, with the lowest piece resting near ground level so the whole structure keeps its natural hanging height.

I'll design it as a recursive tree of arms and wires, each node either ending in a flat extruded shape (disk, leaf, crescent, triangle) in black/red/blue/yellow/white or branching into a sub-arm, built statically without joints. For positioning, I'll construct the tree top-down symbolically first, then compute the lowest point and shift the whole thing so it touches y=0.

I'm tracking rods and shapes as item lists with positions, colors, and sizes, plus a small hook at the ceiling for the hanging wire.

Defining outline shapes...
